hub.notes: Late-arriving buttons can now join: the hub opens scan windows at game start and while any add-players screen is open, so a button powered on mid-game connects and can be added. Battery-critical red light is actually red now (RGBW color support). Plus mid-game join correctness fixes.

node.notes: Locate now flashes the full 30 seconds (routine LED traffic no longer cancels it) and the low-battery warning light is actually red.
